narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open in a dim church, at the evening office. One line for the day. No second sermon written in. On the almanack. The margin empty. Heads are bowed nearer the front. His own page has no new word. The book is not the commination.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood the office and left the almanac blank under the line.

entities.name: almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in The office, and not a second reading
